text.en:
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 397 June 27, 1972
EXTENDING THE TERM OF THE PRESIDENTIAL COMMISSION ON REORGANIZATION
CREATED UNDER EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 281, S. 1970
WHEREAS, the Integrated Reorganization Plan has already been submitted to Congress last March 4, 1972,
pursuant to Section 4 of Republic Act No. 5435, as amended;
WHEREAS, it is desirable to maintain the active involvement of the members of the Presidential Commission
on Reorganization in the consideration of the Integrated Reorganization Plan by Congress and in its eventual
approval; and
WHEREAS, it is necessary that the Commission undertake such informational activities as may be necessary
to ensure wider understanding and support of the reorganization proposals;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by law, do hereby extend the term of the Presidential Commission on Reorganization and the
necessary technical staff thereof, from July 1, 1972 to September 30, 1972, to perform the following:
1. Participate and render such technical assistance as may be required by Congress in its consideration of the
Integrated Reorganization Plan;
2. Act as liaison and render such services for the Office of the President as may be necessary to ensure the
approval of the reorganization plan by Congress;
3. Undertake such informational activities as may be necessary to ensure wider understanding and support of
the reorganization proposals; and
4. Perform such other functions as may be necessary to accomplish the foregoing objectives.
The Executive Secretary shall issue the necessary directives to the other government agencies with personnel
detailed to the Commission for the extension of the detail of such personnel whose services may still be
needed by the Commission.
The Commission is authorized to disburse and defray all expenses for its operations from July 1 to September
30, 1972 and avail of funds that shall be provided for it under a special budget in the Office of the President,
including compensation of all the regular personnel. The Commission is also authorized to grant to the
personnel of the technical staff whose detail are extended from other government offices as well as those who
may be on consultancy basis from the private sector, including the members of the Commission honorarium
and/or allowances in such reasonable amounts as it may determine.
Done in the City of Manila, this 27th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-two.
